Precondition:
1. registry-center is deployed via docker compose and has passed the health check
2. A valid AgentCard payload has been prepared
Steps:
1. POST /rest/v1/registry-center/agent-cards to submit the AgentCard see result 1
2. GET /rest/v1/registry-center/agent-cards/{org}/{name} to query that AgentCard see result 2
3. Cleanup: delete the AgentCard registered in this case
Expected Result:
1. Registration succeeds and returns 201
2. The query returns fields consistent with the submitted content
3. A subsequent query returns 404 and the test data has been cleaned up

Case Name: Service self-heals after registry-center container stop
Precondition:
1. registry-center is deployed with at least 1 Agent registered
2. A docker compose environment is available
Steps:
1. Record the current list of registered Agents
2. docker compose stop registry-center to stop the service
3. docker compose start registry-center to recover the service see result 1
4. Cleanup: delete the test-registered Agent data
Expected Result:
1. After the service recovers, the original Agent is still retrievable with no data loss; the process is automatically brought up without manual intervention
2. After cleanup, the query returns 404
